title: Deserts of the world
examples: Which desert is located in Asia?

explain.say: Today we are learning about some big deserts around the world.

draw.text: World Deserts: Sahara, Gobi, Arabian, Atacama, Antarctica

explain.say: The Sahara is a very large hot desert in North Africa.
The Gobi desert is a cold desert found in Asia.
The Arabian desert is a hot desert in the Middle East.
The Atacama desert is famous for being very dry in South America.
Antarctica is a desert because it gets very little plant life.

faq.q: Which desert is the largest overall?
faq.a: Antarctica is considered the largest desert because it receives very little rainfall.
No, deserts can be hot like the Sahara or very cold like Antarctica.
A desert is characterized by very low levels of precipitation, or rainfall.

faq.q: Where is the Gobi desert located?
faq.a: The Gobi desert is located in a region of Asia.
asks: Which Asian desert do I learn about?
Can you point to the Gobi?

faq.q: What is the Atacama desert known for?
faq.a: The Atacama desert is known for being extremely dry, even having salt deposits.

facts: Deserts are defined by low levels of precipitation, not just temperature.
Antarctica is a polar desert, meaning it is cold.
The Sahara is one of the world's largest hot deserts.
The Atacama desert is one of the driest places on Earth.

quiz.say: Which desert is located in North Africa?
quiz.why: The Sahara is correctly placed in North Africa.

wrong.1: The Gobi is located in Asia, not North Africa.
wrong.2: The Arabian desert is in the Middle East.
wrong.3: The Atacama desert is in South America.

quiz.say: Which desert is known for being very dry in South America?
quiz.why: The Atacama desert is famous for its extreme dryness in South America.

wrong.0: The Gobi is a cold desert found in Asia.
wrong.1: The Arabian desert is in the Middle East region.
wrong.3: The Sahara is a hot desert, but not the one in South America.

quiz.say: What type of desert is Antarctica?
quiz.why: Antarctica is a polar desert because it is defined by low rainfall, not just heat.

wrong.0: While it is cold, the classification based on water is better.
wrong.1: Tropical deserts are usually associated with warm climates.
wrong.3: Hot deserts are characterized by high temperatures.
